question: Which chapter of the Uḍḍāmareśvara Tantra concludes at this point?
premises: The text is the Uḍḍāmareśvara Tantra
inference: This marks the ninth chapter, the yakṣiṇī chapter, in the Uḍḍāmareśvara Tantra.
plain_english: In the Uḍḍāmareśvara Tantra, this is the ninth chapter, the chapter on the yakṣiṇī.
